summary: schema missing; shape official type=string, enum[5] vs generated —; 1 absent

answer.why_different: The generated document omits the entire reusable schema, so this is a structural omission rather than a different value or address. The omission removes the official string enumeration from components.schemas.
answer.spec_3gpp: The 3GPP evidence identifies notification types including notifyMOICreation, notifyMOIDeletion, notifyMOIAttributeValueChanges, and notifyMOIChanges. The supplied evidence does not explicitly document notifyEvent, but it confirms that these notification-type values are defined by the specification.
answer.openapi: OpenAPI 3.0 defines components.schemas as the location for reusable Schema Objects. Omitting this schema loses the reusable type definition and its permitted values from the document.
answer.clearer_why: The official side explicitly shows the schema type and all enum values. The generated side provides no definition, so a reader cannot determine the allowed notification-type values from this schema.

##### 12.1.3.2.5 Notification notifyMOIChanges  
The NETCONF/YANG solution set uses the same mapping as the RESTful
HTTP-based solution set as described in clause 12.1.1.2.5 with the
changes and additions described below.  
\- Any changes reported are based on the YANG NRM definitions, even
though the RESTful notification mapping is reused.  
\- The media type as specified by the \"Content-Type\" header in the
HTTP POST request shall be \"application/yang-data+json\" and not
\"application/json\".  
\- The value of \"href\" shall be set to the FQDN or IP address
